title: Three-Dimensional Modified Dirac Oscillator in Standard and Generalized Doubly Special Relativity
summary: % Doubly Special Relativity (DSR) introduces, besides the invariant speed of light $c$, an observer-independent high-energy % scale that deforms relativistic kinematics and can be implemented through modified dispersion relations or effective % wave equations with energy-dependent spatial operators. In this work we develop a three-dimensional, exactly solvable % benchmark for such deformations in the spin-$\tfrac12$ sector: the Dirac oscillator.
